Pero esta típica frase de madre o abuelo tiene bastante de mito detrás, como demostró un médico que estuvo crujiéndose los nudillos durante muchos años para ver el efecto que tenía. Un médico alergólogo llamado Donald L. Unger estaba harto de escuchar estas advertencias durante su infancia y es por ello que optó por convertir su cuerpo en un laboratorio a largo plazo. item.title: Africa's water availability sometimes goes untapped
item.description: Water demand in Africa grew by around 26% between 2010 and 2020, yet around 717 million people lacked a piped water supply in 2020, according to research published in Nature. The findings indicate that water scarcity in some parts of Africa may be due to a lack of infrastructure, rather than a lack of available water. The work provides a comprehensive map for water demand in different sectors, highlighting issues that need to be addressed to increase the availability of water in Africa, which forms part of Sustainable Development Goal 6. Fuente: Phys.org.

The Russia-Africa summit marks a renewed Kremlin effort to bolster ties with a continent of nearly 1.6 billion people that is increasingly assertive on the global stage. item.title: Wildlife traffickers may have killed her family to capture her; rescued baby gorilla Bili begins a second life in Congo
item.description: Bili, the young gorilla saved from wildlife trafficking in Nigeria, has embarked on a fresh journey in the Republic of the Congo.
